collection.description: An elder asks to become a beginner in a skill commonly taught to children and worries others will laugh.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder) asks to become a beginner in a skill commonly taught to children and worries others will laugh.

choices.label: Pair Them with a Patient Teen
Celebrate the Attempt Rather Than Mastery

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (teen) teaches carefully, and (elder) becomes a proud beginner.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (elder) struggles at first, and (teen) adapts the explanation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Everyone discovers that different ages bring different strengths.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) teaches a shortcut that surprises the adult instructor.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) gains confidence before joining a group.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They decide private learning suits them and decline a public demonstration.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They ask not to be praised for every tiny step and are treated like any other learner.
